projects.name: A Block-Based Functional Programming Language
description: A block-based functional programming language that takes inspiration of syntax and semantics from Haskell, among other functional programming languages. This project involved the design the syntactic elements of a block-based functional programming language, as well as the development of a web-based IDE using Blockly for said language, in aim to create a tool to aid in the teaching of functional languages to novice programmers.

projects.name: A Web-Based Medical Data Dashboard
description: A dashboard that displays visualisations of healthcare data, collected from Garmin and FitBit smart-watch devices. Created in React, this dashboard connects to a Postgres database for real-time data updates, and a Flask REST API to receive AI-enhanced insights and predictions.
Key Modules: Software Engineering Group Project, Advanced Programming Language Concepts, Machine Learning Technologies, Advanced Databases, and Automated Software Verification.
Activities: President and Founder of the Programming Language Society, Marketing Officer for the Electronics and Computer Science Society, and University Ambassador and ECS Student Representative.
